    def submit_order(
        self,
        *,
        asset: AlpacaAsset,
        side: str | Enum,
        order_type: str | Enum,
        sizing: OrderSizing | None = None,
        qty: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
        notional: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
        limit_price: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
        time_in_force: str | Enum = "day",
        cycle_id: str,
        purpose: OrderPurpose | str | Enum,
        attempt: int = 0,
        known_position_qty: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
    ) -> AlpacaOrder | NotSubmitted:
        """Submit a stock BUY/SELL market or limit order exactly once."""

        self._require_live_authorization()
        asset = self._validate_asset(asset)
        if sizing is not None and (qty is not None or notional is not None):
            raise ValueError("pass sizing or qty/notional, not both")
        resolved_sizing = sizing if sizing is not None else OrderSizing(qty=qty, notional=notional)
        if not isinstance(resolved_sizing, OrderSizing):
            raise TypeError("sizing must be an OrderSizing")
        resolved_side = _enum_string(side, field="side", allowed=frozenset({"buy", "sell"}))
        resolved_type = _enum_string(
            order_type, field="order_type", allowed=frozenset({"market", "limit"})
        )
        tif = _enum_string(
            time_in_force, field="time_in_force", allowed=frozenset({"day", "gtc"})
        )
        validated = self._validate_sizing(resolved_sizing, asset, tif=tif)
        if resolved_type == "limit":
            if limit_price is None:
                raise ValueError("limit orders require limit_price")
            price = quantize_price(limit_price, asset, strict=True)
        else:
            if limit_price is not None:
                raise ValueError("market orders must not specify limit_price")
            price = None
        validated_qty = validated.qty
        assert validated_qty is None or isinstance(validated_qty, Decimal)
        self._check_oversell(validated_qty, resolved_side, known_position_qty)
        body: dict[str, Any] = {
            "symbol": asset.symbol,
            "side": resolved_side,
            "type": resolved_type,
            "time_in_force": tif,
        }
        if validated.qty is not None:
            body["qty"] = str(validated.qty)
        else:
            body["notional"] = str(validated.notional)
        if price is not None:
            body["limit_price"] = str(price)
        return self._submit(body, cycle_id=cycle_id, purpose=purpose, attempt=attempt)

    def submit_stop_sell(
        self,
        *,
        asset: AlpacaAsset,
        qty: Decimal | int | str,
        stop_price: Decimal | int | str,
        known_position_qty: Decimal | int | str,
        capability_check: Callable[[str], bool] | None,
        time_in_force: str | Enum = "day",
        cycle_id: str,
        attempt: int = 0,
    ) -> AlpacaOrder | NotSubmitted:
        """Submit a capability-proven standalone protective stop SELL."""

        self._require_live_authorization()
        asset = self._validate_asset(asset)
        tif = _enum_string(
            time_in_force, field="time_in_force", allowed=frozenset({"day", "gtc"})
        )
        raw_qty = _positive_decimal(qty, field="qty")
        fractional = raw_qty != raw_qty.to_integral_value()
        capability = f"standalone_stop_sell:{'fractional' if fractional else 'whole'}:{tif}"
        self._require_capability(capability_check, capability)
        sizing = self._validate_sizing(OrderSizing(qty=raw_qty), asset, tif=tif)
        normalized_qty = sizing.qty
        assert isinstance(normalized_qty, Decimal)
        self._check_oversell(normalized_qty, "sell", known_position_qty)
        price = quantize_price(stop_price, asset, strict=True)
        body = {
            "symbol": asset.symbol,
            "qty": str(normalized_qty),
            "side": "sell",
            "type": "stop",
            "time_in_force": tif,
            "stop_price": str(price),
        }
        return self._submit(
            body,
            cycle_id=cycle_id,
            purpose=OrderPurpose.PROTECTIVE_STOP,
            attempt=attempt,
        )

    def submit_trailing_stop_sell(
        self,
        *,
        asset: AlpacaAsset,
        qty: Decimal | int | str,
        known_position_qty: Decimal | int | str,
        capability_check: Callable[[str], bool] | None,
        trail_price: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
        trail_percent: Decimal | int | str | None = None,
        time_in_force: str | Enum = "day",
        cycle_id: str,
        attempt: int = 0,
    ) -> AlpacaOrder | NotSubmitted:
        """Submit a standalone native trailing-stop SELL (never a linked leg)."""

        self._require_live_authorization()
        asset = self._validate_asset(asset)
        if (trail_price is None) == (trail_percent is None):
            raise ValueError("exactly one of trail_price or trail_percent is required")
        tif = _enum_string(
            time_in_force, field="time_in_force", allowed=frozenset({"day", "gtc"})
        )
        raw_qty = _positive_decimal(qty, field="qty")
        fractional = raw_qty != raw_qty.to_integral_value()
        quantity_kind = "fractional" if fractional else "whole"
        capability = f"standalone_trailing_stop_sell:{quantity_kind}:{tif}"
        self._require_capability(capability_check, capability)
        sizing = self._validate_sizing(OrderSizing(qty=raw_qty), asset, tif=tif)
        normalized_qty = sizing.qty
        assert isinstance(normalized_qty, Decimal)
        self._check_oversell(normalized_qty, "sell", known_position_qty)
        body: dict[str, Any] = {
            "symbol": asset.symbol,
            "qty": str(normalized_qty),
            "side": "sell",
            "type": "trailing_stop",
            "time_in_force": tif,
        }
        if trail_price is not None:
            body["trail_price"] = str(quantize_price(trail_price, asset, strict=True))
        else:
            body["trail_percent"] = str(
                _positive_decimal(trail_percent, field="trail_percent")
            )
        return self._submit(
            body,
            cycle_id=cycle_id,
            purpose=OrderPurpose.TRAILING_STOP,
            attempt=attempt,
        )

    def get_order(self, order_id: str) -> AlpacaOrder | None:
        cleaned = _require_text(order_id, field="order_id")
        try:
            data = self._client.get(f"/v2/orders/{cleaned}", params=None)
        except Exception as exc:  # duck-typed fakes preserve provider status_code
            if self._status_code(exc) == 404:
                return None
            raise
        return self._normalize_response(data, endpoint="GET /v2/orders/{id}")

    def get_order_by_client_order_id(self, client_order_id: str) -> AlpacaOrder | None:
        cleaned = _require_text(client_order_id, field="client_order_id")
        try:
            data = self._client.get(
                "/v2/orders:by_client_order_id",
                params={"client_order_id": cleaned},
            )
        except Exception as exc:  # duck-typed fakes preserve provider status_code
            if self._status_code(exc) == 404:
                return None
            raise
        return self._normalize_response(data, endpoint="GET /v2/orders:by_client_order_id")

    def list_open_orders(self, *, limit: int = 100, nested: bool = True) -> list[AlpacaOrder]:
        if isinstance(limit, bool) or not isinstance(limit, int) or not 1 <= limit <= 500:
            raise ValueError("limit must be an int between 1 and 500")
        if not isinstance(nested, bool):
            raise ValueError("nested must be bool")
        data = self._client.get(
            "/v2/orders",
            params={"status": "open", "limit": limit, "nested": nested},
        )
        if not isinstance(data, list):
            raise ValueError("GET /v2/orders must return a JSON array")
        return [
            self._normalize_response(item, endpoint="GET /v2/orders") for item in data
        ]

    def cancel_order(self, order_id: str) -> CancelResult:
        self._require_live_authorization()
        cleaned = _require_text(order_id, field="order_id")
        try:
            self._client.delete(f"/v2/orders/{cleaned}", params=None)
        except Exception as exc:  # 404/422 are idempotent terminal outcomes
            if self._status_code(exc) in {404, 422}:
                return CancelResult(
                    order_id=cleaned,
                    cancel_requested=False,
                    already_terminal=True,
                    status="already_terminal",
                )
            raise
        return CancelResult(
            order_id=cleaned,
            cancel_requested=True,
            already_terminal=False,
            status="cancel_requested",
        )

    def list_activities(
        self,
        *,
        activity_types: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
        activity_type: str | None = None,
        date: str | Date | datetime | None = None,
        after: str | Date | datetime | None = None,
        until: str | Date | datetime | None = None,
        direction: str | None = None,
        order_id: str | None = None,
        page_size: int | None = None,
        max_pages: int | None = None,
    ) -> list[NormalizedActivity]:
        """Read activities using page tokens, stopping at the hard page cap."""

        if activity_types is not None and activity_type is not None:
            raise ValueError("pass activity_types or activity_type, not both")
        resolved_page_size = self._page_size if page_size is None else page_size
        resolved_max_pages = self._max_pages if max_pages is None else max_pages
        self._validate_page_size(resolved_page_size)
        self._validate_max_pages(resolved_max_pages)
        if resolved_max_pages > self._max_pages:
            raise ValueError(
                f"max_pages cannot exceed the configured hard cap of {self._max_pages}"
            )
        params: dict[str, Any] = {"page_size": resolved_page_size}
        chosen_types: str | Sequence[str] | None = (
            activity_types if activity_types is not None else activity_type
        )
        if chosen_types is not None:
            if isinstance(chosen_types, str):
                normalized_types = _require_text(chosen_types, field="activity_types").upper()
            else:
                normalized_types = ",".join(
                    _require_text(item, field="activity_types item").upper()
                    for item in chosen_types
                )
                if not normalized_types:
                    raise ValueError("activity_types must not be empty")
            params["activity_types"] = normalized_types
        for name, value in (("date", date), ("after", after), ("until", until)):
            if value is not None:
                params[name] = self._format_filter(value, field=name)
        if direction is not None:
            normalized_direction = _require_text(direction, field="direction").lower()
            if normalized_direction not in {"asc", "desc"}:
                raise ValueError("direction must be 'asc' or 'desc'")
            params["direction"] = normalized_direction
        if order_id is not None:
            params["order_id"] = _require_text(order_id, field="order_id")

        result: list[NormalizedActivity] = []
        previous_token: str | None = None
        for _page_number in range(resolved_max_pages):
            response = self._client.get("/v2/account/activities", params=dict(params))
            items, explicit_token = self._page(response)
            result.extend(self.normalize_activity(item) for item in items)

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ProtectionEligibility:
    status: str
    reason_code: str | None
    risk_notes: tuple[str, ...]
    entry_allowed: bool

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.status not in {_ALLOWED, _REJECTED}:
            raise ValueError("status must be ALLOWED or REJECTED")
        if (self.reason_code is None) != (self.status == _ALLOWED):
            raise ValueError("REJECTED requires a reason code; ALLOWED must not have one")

    @property
    def allowed(self) -> bool:
        return self.status == _ALLOWED

    @property
    def rejected(self) -> bool:
        return self.status == _REJECTED


def _result(policy: ProtectionPolicy, reason: str | None = None) -> ProtectionEligibility:
    allowed = reason is None
    return ProtectionEligibility(
        status=_ALLOWED if allowed else _REJECTED,
        reason_code=reason,
        risk_notes=_RISK_NOTES,
        entry_allowed=allowed or not policy.required,
    )


def evaluate_policy(
    policy: ProtectionPolicy,
    capabilities: BrokerProtectionCapabilities,
    execution_mode: ExecutionMode | object,
    quantity: Decimal,
) -> ProtectionEligibility:
    """Return a deterministic, fail-closed capability decision."""

    if not isinstance(policy, ProtectionPolicy):
        raise TypeError("policy must be ProtectionPolicy")
    if not isinstance(capabilities, BrokerProtectionCapabilities):
        raise TypeError("capabilities must be BrokerProtectionCapabilities")
    if not isinstance(quantity, Decimal):
        raise TypeError("quantity must be Decimal")
    if not quantity.is_finite() or quantity <= _ZERO:
        raise ValueError("quantity must be a finite positive Decimal")
    live = _mode_value(execution_mode) == ExecutionMode.LIVE.value

    if policy.mode is ProtectionMode.TRAILING_STEPPED:
        return _result(policy, "STEPPED_NOT_AVAILABLE")
    if policy.mode not in {ProtectionMode.FIXED, ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE}:
        return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_MODE")

    order_type = (
        _TRAILING_STOP
        if policy.mode is ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE
        else str(policy.order_semantics)
    )
    tif = policy.time_in_force
    assert isinstance(tif, TimeInForce)

    if order_type not in capabilities.supported_order_types:
        return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_TYPE")
    if live and order_type not in capabilities.paper_proven_order_types:
        return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_TYPE")

    if tif not in capabilities.supported_tifs:
        return _result(policy, "TIF_NOT_SUPPORTED")
    if live and tif not in capabilities.paper_proven_tifs:
        return _result(policy, "TIF_NOT_SUPPORTED")

    trail_parameter: str | None = None
    if policy.mode is ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE:
        trail_parameter = _TRAIL_PRICE if policy.trail_price is not None else _TRAIL_PERCENT
        if not policy.linked:
            if trail_parameter not in capabilities.standalone_trailing_parameters:
                return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_TYPE")
            if (
                live
                and trail_parameter
                not in capabilities.paper_proven_standalone_trailing_parameters
            ):
                return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_TYPE")

    if policy.linked:
        if policy.mode is ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE:
            if trail_parameter not in capabilities.linked_trailing_parameters:
                return _result(policy, "LINKED_TRAILING_UNSUPPORTED")
            if live and trail_parameter not in capabilities.paper_proven_linked_trailing_parameters:
                return _result(policy, "LINKED_TRAILING_UNSUPPORTED")
        else:
            if order_type not in capabilities.linked_order_types:
                return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_TYPE")
            if live and order_type not in capabilities.paper_proven_linked_order_types:
                return _result(policy, "UNSUPPORTED_ORDER_TYPE")

    fractional = quantity != quantity.to_integral_value()
    if fractional:
        if (
            not policy.allow_fractional_protection
            or policy.documented_fractional_risk_ack is None
        ):
            return _result(policy, "FRACTIONAL_NOT_SUPPORTED")
        combination = (order_type, tif)
        if combination not in capabilities.fractional_combinations:
            return _result(policy, "FRACTIONAL_NOT_SUPPORTED")
        if live and combination not in capabilities.paper_proven_fractional_combinations:
            return _result(policy, "FRACTIONAL_NOT_PAPER_PROVEN")

    return _result(policy)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not self.name.strip() or ":" in self.name:
            raise ValueError("scenario name must be non-empty and contain no ':'")
        if self.name.upper() in {"PAPER", "LIVE"}:
            raise ValueError("scenario name collides with a broker environment")
        if self.total_budget < self.per_symbol_budget:
            raise ValueError("total_budget must be >= per_symbol_budget")

class ShadowBrokerGroup:
    """One isolated durable simulated account per named SHADOW scenario."""

    environment = AccountEnvironment.SHADOW

    def __init__(
        self,
        persistence: SQLitePersistence,
        clock: ClockPort,
        account_id: str,
        scenarios: Sequence[ShadowScenarioSettings],
    ) -> None:
        self.persistence = persistence
        self.clock = clock
        self.account_id = account_id
        self.configs = tuple(scenarios)
        self.scenarios: dict[str, _ShadowScenario] = {}

    def validate_startup(self) -> bool:
        if self.persistence.session is None:
            raise RuntimeError("persistence must be opened before shadow accounts")
        if self.scenarios:
            return True
        for config in self.configs:
            scope = AccountScope(AccountEnvironment.SHADOW, self.account_id, config.name)
            ledger = ShadowLedger(
                self.persistence.session.bind_scope(scope.scope_id), scope, clock=self.clock
            )
            fills = ShadowFillSimulator(config.fill_assumptions)
            account = (
                ShadowAccount.open(ledger)
                if ledger.read_events()
                else ShadowAccount.create(
                    ledger,
                    starting_cash=config.starting_cash,
                    per_symbol_budget=config.per_symbol_budget,
                    total_budget=config.total_budget,
                    eligibility=EntryEligibilityPolicy(
                        config.max_entry_cycles_per_session,
                        config.consecutive_loss_limit,
                        config.lockout_scope_by_strategy,
                        config.post_sale_cooldown,
                        config.minimum_hold,
                    ),
                    allow_fractional=config.allow_fractional,
                    assumptions=config.fill_assumptions.as_mapping(),
                    feed="iex:shadow",
                )
            )
            providers = _CoordinatorProviders(account)
            coordinator = OrderCommandCoordinator(
                clock=self.clock,
                quote_age_provider=providers,
                open_order_provider=providers,
                position_provider=providers,
                buying_power_budget_provider=providers,
                max_quote_age=timedelta(seconds=90),
            )
            self.scenarios[config.name] = _ShadowScenario(
                config,
                ledger,
                account,
                fills,
                ShadowStopSimulator(account),
                {},
                coordinator,
            )
        return True

    def primary(self) -> ShadowAccount:
        self.validate_startup()

    def __init__(self, group: ShadowBrokerGroup) -> None:

        self.group.validate_startup()

        for scenario in self.group.scenarios.values():

class _BrokerReconciler:
    """Open-time binding of the production reconciler to the mode database writer."""

    async def stop(self) -> RuntimeStatus:
        """Drain and release resources without any broker trading side effect."""
        if self.state is StartupState.STOPPED:
            return self.status()
        self.state = StartupState.DRAINING
        self.entry_gate.block("SHUTTING_DOWN")
        self._accepting_evaluations = False
        await self._stop_heartbeat_loop()
        await self._heartbeat()
        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(
                _call_optional(self.execution, ("drain", "drain_in_flight")),
                timeout=self.drain_timeout,
            )
        except TimeoutError:
            self.last_error = "evaluation drain timed out"
        await _call_optional(self.scheduler, ("stop", "close"))
        await _call_optional(self.persistence, ("flush", "checkpoint"))
        await _call_optional(self.market_data, ("close", "unsubscribe_all", "stop"))
        await _call_optional(self.persistence, ("close",))
        await _call_optional(self.instance_lock, ("release", "close"))
        self.state = StartupState.STOPPED
        self.completed_steps.append(StartupState.STOPPED)
        self.entry_gate.block("STOPPED")
        self.logger.info("Runtime stopped", extra={"mode": self.mode.value})
        return self.status()

    def install_signal_handlers(self) -> None:
        """Map SIGTERM/SIGINT to graceful ``stop`` on the active event loop."""
        if self._signal_handlers_installed:
            return
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()

        def request_stop() -> None:
            if self.state not in {StartupState.DRAINING, StartupState.STOPPED}:
                loop.create_task(self.stop(), name="mike-trade-graceful-stop")

        for signum in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT):
            try:
                loop.add_signal_handler(signum, request_stop)
            except (NotImplementedError, RuntimeError):
                signal.signal(signum, lambda *_args: request_stop())
        self._signal_handlers_installed = True

"""Pure, broker-independent monotonic stepped trailing-stop ratchet (LONG only).

Nothing here performs I/O or touches a broker, clock, persistence layer, or
order: every function maps explicit inputs to a value.  The module only
*computes stop candidates*; a coordinator decides whether and how to replace a
live protective order.

Model
-----
* ``initial_state`` starts with ``high_watermark == ratchet_anchor ==
  entry_reference`` and ``candidate_stop = entry_reference - distance``.
* ``advance`` raises ``high_watermark`` to ``max(previous, observed_high)``,
  counts the complete favorable steps ``(high_watermark - ratchet_anchor) //
  step`` and moves the anchor up by exactly that many whole steps (a single
  jump may cross several steps).  The candidate stop is
  ``ratchet_anchor - distance``.  Sub-step highs do not reprice.
* The watermark, anchor and candidate stop never decrease; a lower observed
  high changes nothing.  ``steps_advanced`` is the number of whole steps taken
  by the most recent ``initial_state`` (0) / ``advance`` call, not a running
  total.
* ``should_replace`` floors the candidate to the broker tick grid via an
  injected rounder *before* comparing, and answers True only when the rounded
  candidate is strictly above the last confirmed stop.

Documented basis (design decision)
----------------------------------
PERCENT distances **and** PERCENT steps are both computed on the *entry
reference*, never on the moving high watermark or anchor:
``amount = entry_reference * pct / 100``.  The resulting USD amounts are
therefore constant for the life of the position, which keeps the ratchet
deterministic and replay-stable.

Validation: all prices and amounts must be finite ``Decimal`` values; ``float``
(and ``bool``/``int``) inputs are rejected with ``ValueError``.  The SHORT side
is an explicit capability boundary and raises ``NotImplementedError``.
"""

_ZERO = Decimal("0")
_HUNDRED = Decimal("100")
_LONG = "LONG"
_SHORT = "SHORT"


class DistanceKind(StrEnum):
    USD = "USD"
    PERCENT = "PERCENT"


def _decimal(value: object, name: str, *, positive: bool = False) -> Decimal:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, Decimal):
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a Decimal, not {type(value).__name__}")
    if not value.is_finite():
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite Decimal")
    if positive and value <= _ZERO:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be > 0")
    return value


def _kind(value: object, name: str) -> DistanceKind:
    try:
        return DistanceKind(value)
    except ValueError:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be one of {[k.value for k in DistanceKind]}") from None


def _flag(value: object, name: str) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(value, bool):
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a bool")
    return value

    normalized = side.strip().upper() if isinstance(side, str) else side
    if normalized == _SHORT:
        raise NotImplementedError("SHORT-side stepped trailing is not supported")
    if normalized != _LONG:
        raise ValueError("side must be 'LONG'")

class SteppedTrailingPolicy:
    """Immutable stepped-trailing configuration."""

    distance_kind: DistanceKind
    distance_value: Decimal
    step_kind: DistanceKind
    step_value: Decimal
    min_replace_interval: timedelta
    time_in_force: TimeInForce
    policy_revision: str
    requires_standalone_stop: bool = True
    requires_stop_replace: bool = True

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        object.__setattr__(self, "distance_kind", _kind(self.distance_kind, "distance_kind"))
        object.__setattr__(self, "step_kind", _kind(self.step_kind, "step_kind"))
        _decimal(self.distance_value, "distance_value", positive=True)
        _decimal(self.step_value, "step_value", positive=True)
        if not isinstance(self.min_replace_interval, timedelta) or self.min_replace_interval < timedelta(0):
            raise ValueError("min_replace_interval must be a timedelta >= 0")
        tif = self.time_in_force
        if isinstance(tif, str):
            try:
                tif = TimeInForce[tif.strip().upper()]
            except KeyError:
                raise ValueError("time_in_force must be a TimeInForce (DAY/GTC)") from None
        if not isinstance(tif, TimeInForce):
            raise ValueError("time_in_force must be a TimeInForce (DAY/GTC)")
        object.__setattr__(self, "time_in_force", tif)
        if not isinstance(self.policy_revision, str) or not self.policy_revision.strip():
            raise ValueError("policy_revision must be a non-empty string")
        object.__setattr__(self, "policy_revision", self.policy_revision.strip())
        _flag(self.requires_standalone_stop, "requires_standalone_stop")
        _flag(self.requires_stop_replace, "requires_stop_replace")

    def distance_amount(self, entry_reference: Decimal) -> Decimal:
        """Trailing distance in USD (percent is taken on the entry reference)."""

        return _amount(self.distance_kind, self.distance_value, entry_reference)

    def step_amount(self, entry_reference: Decimal) -> Decimal:
        """Step increment in USD (percent is taken on the entry reference)."""

        return _amount(self.step_kind, self.step_value, entry_reference)


def _amount(kind: DistanceKind, value: Decimal, entry_reference: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    if kind is DistanceKind.USD:
        return value
    return entry_reference * value / _HUNDRED


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SteppedTrailingState:
    """Ratchet state; also the result type returned by ``initial_state``/``advance``."""

    entry_reference: Decimal
    high_watermark: Decimal
    ratchet_anchor: Decimal
    candidate_stop: Decimal
    steps_advanced: int = 0

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for name in ("entry_reference", "high_watermark", "ratchet_anchor", "candidate_stop"):
            _decimal(getattr(self, name), name, positive=True)
        if isinstance(self.steps_advanced, bool) or not isinstance(self.steps_advanced, int):
            raise ValueError("steps_advanced must be an int")
        if self.steps_advanced < 0:
            raise ValueError("steps_advanced must be >= 0")
        if self.high_watermark < self.ratchet_anchor:
            raise ValueError("high_watermark must be >= ratchet_anchor")
        if self.candidate_stop >= self.ratchet_anchor:
            raise ValueError("candidate_stop must be below ratchet_anchor")


RatchetResult = SteppedTrailingState


def _check_policy(policy: object) -> SteppedTrailingPolicy:
    if not isinstance(policy, SteppedTrailingPolicy):
        raise ValueError("policy must be a SteppedTrailingPolicy")
    return policy


def initial_state(
    entry_reference: Decimal, policy: SteppedTrailingPolicy, *, side: str = _LONG
) -> SteppedTrailingState:
    """Initial stop is ``entry_reference - distance``; it must stay positive."""

    _require_long(side)
    policy = _check_policy(policy)
    entry = _decimal(entry_reference, "entry_reference", positive=True)
    stop = entry - policy.distance_amount(entry)
    if stop <= _ZERO:
        raise ValueError("trailing distance must be smaller than entry_reference")
    return SteppedTrailingState(
        entry_reference=entry,
        high_watermark=entry,
        ratchet_anchor=entry,
        candidate_stop=stop,
        steps_advanced=0,
    )


def advance(
    state: SteppedTrailingState,
    observed_high: Decimal,
    policy: SteppedTrailingPolicy,
    *,
    side: str = _LONG,
) -> RatchetResult:
    """Fold an observed high into ``state``; the candidate stop never decreases."""

    _require_long(side)
    policy = _check_policy(policy)
    if not isinstance(state, SteppedTrailingState):
        raise ValueError("state must be a SteppedTrailingState")
    high = _decimal(observed_high, "observed_high", positive=True)
    entry = state.entry_reference
    watermark = max(state.high_watermark, high)
    step = policy.step_amount(entry)
    steps = int((watermark - state.ratchet_anchor) // step)
    anchor = state.ratchet_anchor + step * steps
    # max() keeps the stop monotonic even if the caller swapped in a policy
    # with a wider distance between calls.
    stop = max(state.candidate_stop, anchor - policy.distance_amount(entry))
    return SteppedTrailingState(
        entry_reference=entry,
        high_watermark=watermark,
        ratchet_anchor=anchor,
        candidate_stop=stop,
        steps_advanced=steps,
    )

            return self._cycles[cycle]
        except KeyError:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown PositionCycle id: {cycle}") from None

    async def _broker_call(self, preferred: str, fallback: str, request: object) -> object:
        method = getattr(self._broker, preferred, None)
        if not callable(method):
            method = getattr(self._broker, fallback, None)
        if not callable(method):
            raise TypeError(f"broker must provide {preferred}() or {fallback}()")
        return await _await_if_needed(method(request))

    async def _place_protection(self, state: _CycleState) -> None:
        if state.remaining_quantity <= _ZERO:
            return
        if state.protective_order_id is not None:
            raise RuntimeError("cannot place a second effective protective order")
        if state.avg_fill_price is None:
            raise RuntimeError("confirmed average fill price is required for protection")
        request = _ProtectiveOrderRequest(
            cycle_id=state.cycle_id,
            quantity=state.remaining_quantity,
            confirmed_avg_fill_price=state.avg_fill_price,
            policy=self._policy,
            created_at=self._now(),
        )
        try:
            acknowledgement = await self._broker_call(
                "submit_protective_order", "submit_order", request
            )
            state.protective_order_id = _order_id(acknowledgement)
            state.protective_order_quantity = state.remaining_quantity
            state.protective_cumulative_filled = _ZERO
            state.pending_replacement = False
            state.status = "PROTECTION_ACTIVE"
            state.last_error = None
            self._unprotected_cycles.discard(state.cycle_id)
        except Exception as exc:
            self._mark_unprotected(state, f"protective placement failed: {exc}")
            raise RuntimeError(state.last_error) from exc
        self._assert_sell_invariant(state)

    async def _request_replacement(self, state: _CycleState) -> None:
        if state.protective_order_id is None:
            await self._place_protection(state)
            return
        if state.status == "CANCEL_PENDING_FOR_REPLACEMENT":
            return
        state.pending_replacement = True
        state.status = "CANCEL_PENDING_FOR_REPLACEMENT"
        await self._cancel_effective_protection(state)

    async def _cancel_effective_protection(self, state: _CycleState) -> None:
        order_id = state.protective_order_id
        if order_id is None:
            return
        cancel = getattr(self._broker, "cancel_order", None)
        if not callable(cancel):
            self._mark_unprotected(state, "broker must provide cancel_order()")
            raise RuntimeError(state.last_error)
        try:
            await _await_if_needed(cancel(order_id))
        except Exception as exc:
            self._mark_unprotected(state, f"protective cancellation failed: {exc}")
            raise RuntimeError(state.last_error) from exc

    async def _release_pending_exit(self, state: _CycleState) -> None:
        quantity = state.pending_exit_quantity
        if quantity == _ZERO:
            return
        if state.protective_order_id is not None:
            raise RuntimeError("cannot release exit while protection remains effective")
        if quantity > state.remaining_quantity:
            raise RuntimeError("pending exit exceeds confirmed remaining position")
        reason = state.pending_exit_reason
        assert reason is not None
        request = _ExitOrderRequest(state.cycle_id, quantity, reason, self._now())
        try:
            acknowledgement = await self._broker_call("submit_exit_order", "submit_order", request)
            state.working_exit = _WorkingExit(_order_id(acknowledgement), quantity)
            state.pending_exit_quantity = _ZERO
            state.pending_exit_reason = None
            state.status = "EXIT_ACTIVE"
        except Exception as exc:
            self._mark_unprotected(state, f"exit placement failed after protection cancel: {exc}")

+    assert broker.calls[-1] == ("protect", D("5"))

+def test_long_stepped_stop_is_monotonic_on_rising_and_falling_observations() -> None:
+    policy = SteppedTrailingPolicy(
+        distance_kind=DistanceKind.USD, distance_value=D("2"),
+        step_kind=DistanceKind.USD, step_value=D("1"),

+        policy_revision="offline-guard",

+    state = initial_state(D("100"), policy)

+        state = advance(state, high, policy)
+        stops.append(state.candidate_stop)

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_overlapping_discretionary_exit_and_stop_never_submit_two_sells() -> None:
+    broker = BrokerRecorder()
+    coordinator = ProtectionCoordinator(broker, Clock(), fixed_policy())

+    # the queued discretionary sell is discarded.

+def test_paper_and_live_credentials_endpoints_and_scopes_are_isolated(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:

+    assert live.environment is AlpacaEnvironment.LIVE
+    assert credential_fingerprint(paper) != credential_fingerprint(live)

+"""Credential and approval gated Alpaca PAPER order lifecycle verification.
+
+This module is deliberately the only test module here that can open a broker
+connection.  It constructs the production adapter for PAPER and checks the
+resolved endpoint before the first request.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import os
+import time
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from urllib.parse import urlsplit
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.app import AlpacaBrokerAdapter
+from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.auth import AlpacaEnvironment
+from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.capabilities import (
+    CapabilityDescriptor,
+    CapabilityStatus,
+    default_alpaca_capabilities,
+)
+from mike_trade.domain.accounts import AccountEnvironment
+from mike_trade.domain.trading import (
+    OrderIntent,
+    OrderPurpose,
+    OrderSide,
+    OrderType,
+    TimeInForce,
+)
+from mike_trade.risk.protection import ProtectionCoordinator
+from mike_trade.risk.stop_policy import (
+    BrokerProtectionCapabilities,
+    ProtectionMode,
+    ProtectionPolicy,
+)
+from mike_trade.runtime import ExecutionMode
+
+D = Decimal
+PAPER_KEY = "ALPACA_PAPER_KEY_ID"
+PAPER_SECRET = "ALPACA_PAPER_SECRET_KEY"
+LIVE_CREDENTIAL_NAMES = (
+    "ALPACA_LIVE_KEY_ID",
+    "ALPACA_LIVE_SECRET_KEY",
+    "APCA_API_KEY_ID",
+    "APCA_API_SECRET_KEY",
+    "MIKE_TRADE_ALPACA_LIVE_KEY_ID",
+    "MIKE_TRADE_ALPACA_LIVE_SECRET_KEY",
+)
+
+# Presence alone is enough to stop the module.  Never fetch, print, or use the
+# value of any LIVE credential.
+_live_names_set = [name for name in LIVE_CREDENTIAL_NAMES if name in os.environ]
+if _live_names_set:
+    pytest.exit(
+        "Alpaca PAPER integration aborted: LIVE credential variable(s) are set: "
+        + ", ".join(_live_names_set),
+        returncode=4,
+    )
+
+_missing = [name for name in (PAPER_KEY, PAPER_SECRET) if not os.environ.get(name)]
+if os.environ.get("MIKE_TRADE_PAPER_ORDERS_APPROVED") != "1":
+    _missing.append("MIKE_TRADE_PAPER_ORDERS_APPROVED=1 explicit operator opt-in")
+if not os.environ.get("MIKE_TRADE_PAPER_SYMBOL", "").strip():
+    _missing.append("MIKE_TRADE_PAPER_SYMBOL operator-selected liquid symbol")
+if _missing:
+    pytest.skip(
+        "Alpaca PAPER order cycle skipped; missing precondition(s): " + ", ".join(_missing),
+        allow_module_level=True,
+    )
+
+
+class _Clock:
+    def now(self) -> datetime:
+        return datetime.now(UTC)
+
+
+def _paper_endpoint() -> str:
+    # The production client derives this directly from the adapter's PAPER
+    # environment.  This explicit resolution is checked before startup/network.
+    return AlpacaEnvironment.PAPER.base_url
+
+
+class _ProtectionBroker:
+    """Small bridge to the adapter's real order and asset services."""
+
+    def __init__(self, adapter: AlpacaBrokerAdapter, symbol: str, cycle_id: str,
+                 entry_price: Decimal, qty: Decimal, style: str) -> None:
+        self.adapter, self.symbol, self.cycle_id = adapter, symbol, cycle_id
+        self.entry_price, self.qty, self.style = entry_price, qty, style
+        self.protective_id: str | None = None
+        self.exit_id: str | None = None
+
+    async def submit_protective_order(self, request: object) -> dict[str, str]:
+        orders = self.adapter._orders
+        assets = self.adapter._assets
+        assert orders is not None and assets is not None
+        asset = assets.get_asset(self.symbol)
+        checker = default_alpaca_capabilities().as_legacy_checker(AlpacaEnvironment.PAPER)
+        if self.style == "fixed":
+            price = (self.entry_price * D("0.97")).quantize(D("0.01"))
+            placed = orders.submit_stop_sell(
+                asset=asset, qty=request.quantity, stop_price=price,
+                known_position_qty=request.quantity, capability_check=checker,
+                time_in_force="gtc", cycle_id=self.cycle_id,
+            )
+        else:
+            placed = orders.submit_trailing_stop_sell(
+                asset=asset, qty=request.quantity, known_position_qty=request.quantity,
+                capability_check=checker, trail_percent=D("1.0"),
+                time_in_force="gtc", cycle_id=self.cycle_id,
+            )
+        self.protective_id = placed.order_id
+        return {"broker_order_id": placed.order_id}
+
+    async def submit_exit_order(self, request: object) -> dict[str, str]:
+        from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.orders import OrderPurpose as AlpacaPurpose
+
+        intent = OrderIntent(
+            intent_id=f"{self.cycle_id}-exit", client_order_id=f"{self.cycle_id}-exit-client",
+            account_scope_id=self.adapter.scope.scope_id, cycle_id=self.cycle_id,
+            symbol=self.symbol, side=OrderSide.SELL, purpose=OrderPurpose.MANUAL_CLOSE,
+            order_type=OrderType.MARKET, time_in_force=TimeInForce.DAY,
+            created_at=datetime.now(UTC), quantity=request.quantity,
+        )
+        _ = AlpacaPurpose  # document that adapter uses the broker order purpose scheme
+        order = await self.adapter.submit_order(intent)
+        self.exit_id = order.broker_order_id
+        return {"broker_order_id": self.exit_id}
+
+    async def cancel_order(self, order_id: str) -> object:
+        return await self.adapter.cancel_order(order_id)
+
+
+def _wait_order(adapter: AlpacaBrokerAdapter, order_id: str, timeout: float = 60) -> object:
+    end = time.monotonic() + timeout
+    while time.monotonic() < end:
+        order = asyncio.run(adapter.get_order(order_id))
+        if order is not None and (order.status.value in {"FILLED", "CANCELED", "REJECTED", "EXPIRED"}
+                                  or order.filled_quantity > 0):
+            if order.filled_quantity > 0 or order.status.value in {"CANCELED", "REJECTED", "EXPIRED"}:
+                return order
+        time.sleep(1)
+    raise AssertionError(f"timed out polling paper order {order_id}")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("protection", ["fixed", "native_trailing"])
+def test_real_alpaca_paper_buy_protect_and_flat_cycle(protection: str) -> None:
+    symbol = os.environ["MIKE_TRADE_PAPER_SYMBOL"].strip().upper()
+    quantity_text = os.environ.get("MIKE_TRADE_PAPER_QTY", "1").strip()
+    quantity = D(quantity_text)
+    assert quantity == quantity.to_integral_value() and D("0") < quantity <= D("5"), (
+        "paper cycle quantity must be a whole-share Decimal from 1 through 5"
+    )
+    configured_mode = ExecutionMode(os.environ.get("MIKE_TRADE_MODE", "PAPER").upper())
+    assert configured_mode is ExecutionMode.PAPER
+    endpoint = _paper_endpoint()
+    assert AlpacaEnvironment.from_base_url(endpoint) is AlpacaEnvironment.PAPER
+    assert urlsplit(endpoint).hostname != AlpacaEnvironment.LIVE.base_url.split("//", 1)[1]
+
+    adapter = AlpacaBrokerAdapter(
+        ExecutionMode.PAPER, f"paper-it-{uuid4().hex[:10]}", _Clock(),
+        authorized=False, environ=os.environ,
+    )
+    assert adapter.mode is ExecutionMode.PAPER
+    adapter.validate_startup()
+    assert adapter._client is not None
+    assert adapter._client.environment is AlpacaEnvironment.PAPER
+    assert adapter._client.base_url == endpoint
+    assert urlsplit(adapter._client.base_url).hostname == "paper-api.alpaca.markets"
+    assert urlsplit(adapter._client.base_url).hostname != "api.alpaca.markets"
+
+    clock = adapter._account.get_clock()
+    if not clock.is_open:
+        pytest.skip(f"Alpaca PAPER market clock is closed; next open {clock.next_open.isoformat()}")
+
+    cycle = f"paper-it-{uuid4().hex[:14]}"
+    start = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(minutes=2)
+    created_order_ids: set[str] = set()
+    bought_qty = D("0")
+    try:
+        entry = OrderIntent(
+            intent_id=f"{cycle}-entry", client_order_id=f"{cycle}-entry-client",
+            account_scope_id=adapter.scope.scope_id, cycle_id=cycle, symbol=symbol,
+            side=OrderSide.BUY, purpose=OrderPurpose.ENTRY,
+            order_type=OrderType.MARKET, time_in_force=TimeInForce.DAY,
+            created_at=datetime.now(UTC), quantity=quantity,
+        )
+        submitted = asyncio.run(adapter.submit_order(entry))
+        created_order_ids.add(submitted.broker_order_id)
+        entry_result = _wait_order(adapter, submitted.broker_order_id)
+        bought_qty = entry_result.filled_quantity
+        if bought_qty <= 0:
+            pytest.skip(f"paper entry produced no fill (status={entry_result.status.value})")
+        assert bought_qty <= quantity
+        assert isinstance(entry_result.filled_avg_price, Decimal)
+
+        # REST order polling is the recovery path for the trade_updates stream;
+        # the adapter's production normalizer preserves exact Decimal values.
+        fills = asyncio.run(adapter.list_fills(start))
+        entry_activities = [f for f in fills if f.broker_order_id == submitted.broker_order_id]
+        assert sum((f.quantity for f in entry_activities), D("0")) == bought_qty
+        assert len({f.fill_id for f in entry_activities}) == len(entry_activities)
+
+        capability = CapabilityDescriptor("stop", "simple", "whole", "gtc", "sell", "submit")
+        matrix = default_alpaca_capabilities()
+        assert matrix.status_of(capability, AlpacaEnvironment.PAPER) is CapabilityStatus.PROVEN
+        if protection == "native_trailing":
+            capability = CapabilityDescriptor("trailing_stop", "simple", "whole", "gtc", "sell", "submit")
+            assert matrix.status_of(capability, AlpacaEnvironment.PAPER) is CapabilityStatus.PROVEN
+        protective_broker = _ProtectionBroker(
+            adapter, symbol, cycle, entry_result.filled_avg_price, bought_qty, protection
+        )
+        policy = ProtectionPolicy(
+            mode=(ProtectionMode.FIXED if protection == "fixed" else ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE),
+            distance_percent=D("3") if protection == "fixed" else None,
+            trail_percent=D("1") if protection == "native_trailing" else None,
+            time_in_force=TimeInForce.GTC,
+        )
+        coordinator = ProtectionCoordinator(protective_broker, _Clock(), policy)
+        cap = BrokerProtectionCapabilities(
+            supported_order_types=frozenset({"STOP_MARKET", "TRAILING_STOP"}),
+            paper_proven_order_types=frozenset({"STOP_MARKET", "TRAILING_STOP"}),
+            standalone_trailing_parameters=frozenset({"TRAIL_PERCENT"}),
+            paper_proven_standalone_trailing_parameters=frozenset({"TRAIL_PERCENT"}),
+            supported_tifs=frozenset({TimeInForce.GTC}),
+            paper_proven_tifs=frozenset({TimeInForce.GTC}),
+        )
+        decision = coordinator.check_entry_eligibility(policy, cap, ExecutionMode.PAPER, bought_qty)
+        assert decision.entry_allowed, decision.reason_code
+        protection_state = asyncio.run(coordinator.on_confirmed_fill(
+            cycle, bought_qty, entry_result.filled_avg_price, confirmed=True
+        ))
+        assert protection_state is not None
+        assert protection_state.protective_working_quantity == bought_qty
+        created_order_ids.add(protective_broker.protective_id)
+
+        # The coordinator requests stop cancellation first.  Only after broker
+        # confirms cancellation does it submit a market sell for the actual
+        # remaining position, preventing overlapping sell quantity.
+        pending = asyncio.run(coordinator.on_exit_requested(cycle, bought_qty, "paper-it-cleanup"))
+        assert pending.status.startswith("CANCEL_PENDING")
+        _wait_order(adapter, protective_broker.protective_id)
+        canceled = asyncio.run(coordinator.on_broker_order_update(
+            cycle, protective_broker.protective_id, "CANCELED", filled_qty=D("0")
+        ))
+        assert canceled.exit_working_quantity == bought_qty
+        exit_order = asyncio.run(adapter.get_order(protective_broker.exit_id))
+        assert exit_order is not None
+        created_order_ids.add(exit_order.broker_order_id)
+        exit_result = _wait_order(adapter, exit_order.broker_order_id)
+        assert exit_result.filled_quantity == bought_qty
+        final = asyncio.run(coordinator.on_broker_order_update(
+            cycle, exit_order.broker_order_id, "FILLED", filled_qty=exit_result.filled_quantity,
+            avg_fill_price=exit_result.filled_avg_price,
+        ))
+        assert final.confirmed_remaining_quantity == 0
+
+        positions = asyncio.run(adapter.list_positions())
+        assert not any(position.symbol == symbol for position in positions)
+        all_fills = asyncio.run(adapter.list_fills(start))
+        cycle_fills = [f for f in all_fills if f.broker_order_id in created_order_ids]
+        assert sum((f.quantity if f.side is OrderSide.BUY else -f.quantity for f in cycle_fills), D("0")) == 0
+        assert len({f.fill_id for f in cycle_fills}) == len(cycle_fills), "activity ingestion must be exactly once"
+        assert all(isinstance(f.quantity, Decimal) and isinstance(f.price, Decimal) for f in cycle_fills)
+    finally:
+        # Restrict cleanup to IDs this test received from its own submissions.
+        for order_id in tuple(created_order_ids):
+            try:
+                asyncio.run(adapter.cancel_order(order_id))
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+        positions = asyncio.run(adapter.list_positions())
+        test_position = next((p for p in positions if p.symbol == symbol), None)
+        if test_position is not None and test_position.qty > 0:
+            cleanup = OrderIntent(
+                intent_id=f"{cycle}-cleanup", client_order_id=f"{cycle}-cleanup-client",
+                account_scope_id=adapter.scope.scope_id, cycle_id=cycle, symbol=symbol,
+                side=OrderSide.SELL, purpose=OrderPurpose.MANUAL_CLOSE,
+                order_type=OrderType.MARKET, time_in_force=TimeInForce.DAY,
+                created_at=datetime.now(UTC), quantity=test_position.qty,
+            )
+            try:
+                cleanup_order = asyncio.run(adapter.submit_order(cleanup))
+                if hasattr(cleanup_order, "broker_order_id"):
+                    _wait_order(adapter, cleanup_order.broker_order_id, timeout=30)
+            except Exception:
+                pytest.fail("paper integration cleanup could not close its test-created position")
+
+
+def test_unverified_fractional_protection_and_stepped_trailing_are_blocked() -> None:
+    matrix = default_alpaca_capabilities()
+    fractional_stop = CapabilityDescriptor("stop", "simple", "fractional", "day", "sell", "submit")
+    fractional_trail = CapabilityDescriptor("trailing_stop", "simple", "fractional", "day", "sell", "submit")
+    stepped = CapabilityDescriptor("stop", "simple", "whole", "gtc", "sell", "replace")
+    for descriptor in (fractional_stop, fractional_trail, stepped):
+        assert matrix.status_of(descriptor, AlpacaEnvironment.PAPER) is not CapabilityStatus.PROVEN
+        with pytest.raises(Exception):
+            matrix.require(descriptor, AlpacaEnvironment.PAPER)
+    stepped_policy = ProtectionPolicy(
+        mode=ProtectionMode.TRAILING_STEPPED,
+        distance_usd=D("2"),
+        time_in_force=TimeInForce.GTC,
+    )
+    eligibility = ProtectionCoordinator(object(), _Clock(), stepped_policy).check_entry_eligibility(
+        stepped_policy, BrokerProtectionCapabilities(), ExecutionMode.PAPER, D("1")
+    )
+    assert not eligibility.entry_allowed
+    assert eligibility.reason_code == "STEPPED_NOT_AVAILABLE"

+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.app import AppSettings, build_runtime
+from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.auth import (
+    AlpacaEnvironment,
+    EnvironmentMismatchError,
+    credential_fingerprint,
+    AlpacaCredentials,
+)
+from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.capabilities import (
+    CapabilityDescriptor,
+    CapabilityUnavailable,
+    default_alpaca_capabilities,
+)
+from mike_trade.domain.errors import LiveTradingNotAuthorizedError
+from mike_trade.risk.protection import ProtectionCoordinator
+from mike_trade.risk.stop_policy import (
+    BrokerProtectionCapabilities,
+    ProtectionMode,

+)

+    DistanceKind,

+    advance,
+    initial_state,
+)
+from mike_trade.runtime import ExecutionMode
+from mike_trade.domain.trading import TimeInForce
+
+D = Decimal
+NOW = datetime(2026, 10, 8, 14, 30, tzinfo=UTC)
+
+
+class Clock:
+    def now(self) -> datetime:
+        return NOW
+
+
+class BrokerRecorder:
+    """In-memory broker port used by the production coordinator/runtime."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, fail_cancel: bool = False, fail_protection: bool = False) -> None:
+        self.fail_cancel = fail_cancel
+        self.fail_protection = fail_protection
+        self.calls: list[tuple[str, object]] = []
+        self.sequence = 0
+
+    async def submit_protective_order(self, request: object) -> dict[str, str]:
+        self.calls.append(("protect", request.quantity))
+        if self.fail_protection:
+            raise RuntimeError("protection state unknown")
+        self.sequence += 1
+        return {"broker_order_id": f"stop-{self.sequence}"}
+
+    async def submit_exit_order(self, request: object) -> dict[str, str]:

+"""Offline end-to-end checks for protection coordination and mode isolation."""

+class BrokerRecorder:
+    """In-memory broker port used by the production coordinator/runtime."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, fail_cancel: bool = False, fail_protection: bool = False) -> None:
+        self.fail_cancel = fail_cancel
+        self.fail_protection = fail_protection
+        self.calls: list[tuple[str, object]] = []
+        self.sequence = 0
+
+    async def submit_protective_order(self, request: object) -> dict[str, str]:
+        self.calls.append(("protect", request.quantity))
+        if self.fail_protection:
+            raise RuntimeError("protection state unknown")
+        self.sequence += 1
+        return {"broker_order_id": f"stop-{self.sequence}"}
+
+    async def submit_exit_order(self, request: object) -> dict[str, str]:
+        self.calls.append(("exit", request.quantity))
+        self.sequence += 1
+        return {"broker_order_id": f"exit-{self.sequence}"}
+
+    async def cancel_order(self, order_id: str) -> None:
+        self.calls.append(("cancel", order_id))
+        if self.fail_cancel:
+            raise RuntimeError("cancel outcome unknown")
+

+def fixed_policy() -> ProtectionPolicy:

+    broker = BrokerRecorder()

+    # replaced for the actual cumulative remaining position after confirmation.

+    broker = BrokerRecorder()
+    coordinator = ProtectionCoordinator(broker, Clock(), fixed_policy())
+    await coordinator.on_confirmed_fill("c2", D("3"), D("50"))
+    stop_id = coordinator.current_protection("c2").protective_order_id
+    await coordinator.on_exit_requested("c2", D("3"), "manual")
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="already working|exceeds confirmed"):
+        await coordinator.on_exit_requested("c2", D("1"), "second manual")
+
+    # If the stop wins the race while cancel is pending, it closes the cycle and
+    # the queued discretionary sell is discarded.
+    closed = await coordinator.on_broker_order_update("c2", stop_id, "FILLED", filled_qty=D("3"))
+    assert closed.confirmed_remaining_quantity == D("0")
+    assert not any(call[0] == "exit" for call in broker.calls)
+    assert sum(value for name, value in broker.calls if name == "protect") == D("3")

+"""Credential and approval gated Alpaca PAPER order lifecycle verification.
+
+This module is deliberately the only test module here that can open a broker
+connection.  It constructs the production adapter for PAPER and checks the
+resolved endpoint before the first request.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import os
+import time
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from urllib.parse import urlsplit
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+import pytest

+from mike_trade.app import AlpacaBrokerAdapter
+from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.auth import AlpacaEnvironment

+    CapabilityDescriptor,
+    CapabilityStatus,
+    default_alpaca_capabilities,
+)
+from mike_trade.domain.accounts import AccountEnvironment
+from mike_trade.domain.trading import (
+    OrderIntent,
+    OrderPurpose,
+    OrderSide,
+    OrderType,
+    TimeInForce,
+)
+from mike_trade.risk.protection import ProtectionCoordinator
+from mike_trade.risk.stop_policy import (
+    BrokerProtectionCapabilities,
+    ProtectionMode,
+    ProtectionPolicy,
+)
+from mike_trade.runtime import ExecutionMode
+
+D = Decimal
+PAPER_KEY = "ALPACA_PAPER_KEY_ID"
+PAPER_SECRET = "ALPACA_PAPER_SECRET_KEY"
+LIVE_CREDENTIAL_NAMES = (
+    "ALPACA_LIVE_KEY_ID",
+    "ALPACA_LIVE_SECRET_KEY",
+    "APCA_API_KEY_ID",
+    "APCA_API_SECRET_KEY",
+    "MIKE_TRADE_ALPACA_LIVE_KEY_ID",
+    "MIKE_TRADE_ALPACA_LIVE_SECRET_KEY",
+)
+
+# Presence alone is enough to stop the module.  Never fetch, print, or use the
+# value of any LIVE credential.
+_live_names_set = [name for name in LIVE_CREDENTIAL_NAMES if name in os.environ]
+if _live_names_set:
+    pytest.exit(
+        "Alpaca PAPER integration aborted: LIVE credential variable(s) are set: "
+        + ", ".join(_live_names_set),
+        returncode=4,
+    )
+
+_missing = [name for name in (PAPER_KEY, PAPER_SECRET) if not os.environ.get(name)]
+if os.environ.get("MIKE_TRADE_PAPER_ORDERS_APPROVED") != "1":
+    _missing.append("MIKE_TRADE_PAPER_ORDERS_APPROVED=1 explicit operator opt-in")
+if not os.environ.get("MIKE_TRADE_PAPER_SYMBOL", "").strip():
+    _missing.append("MIKE_TRADE_PAPER_SYMBOL operator-selected liquid symbol")
+if _missing:
+    pytest.skip(
+        "Alpaca PAPER order cycle skipped; missing precondition(s): " + ", ".join(_missing),
+        allow_module_level=True,
+    )
+
+
+class _Clock:
+    def now(self) -> datetime:
+        return datetime.now(UTC)
+
+
+def _paper_endpoint() -> str:
+    # The production client derives this directly from the adapter's PAPER
+    # environment.  This explicit resolution is checked before startup/network.
+    return AlpacaEnvironment.PAPER.base_url
+
+
+class _ProtectionBroker:
+    """Small bridge to the adapter's real order and asset services."""
+
+    def __init__(self, adapter: AlpacaBrokerAdapter, symbol: str, cycle_id: str,
+                 entry_price: Decimal, qty: Decimal, style: str) -> None:
+        self.adapter, self.symbol, self.cycle_id = adapter, symbol, cycle_id
+        self.entry_price, self.qty, self.style = entry_price, qty, style
+        self.protective_id: str | None = None
+        self.exit_id: str | None = None
+
+    async def submit_protective_order(self, request: object) -> dict[str, str]:
+        orders = self.adapter._orders
+        assets = self.adapter._assets
+        assert orders is not None and assets is not None
+        asset = assets.get_asset(self.symbol)
+        checker = default_alpaca_capabilities().as_legacy_checker(AlpacaEnvironment.PAPER)
+        if self.style == "fixed":
+            price = (self.entry_price * D("0.97")).quantize(D("0.01"))
+            placed = orders.submit_stop_sell(
+                asset=asset, qty=request.quantity, stop_price=price,
+                known_position_qty=request.quantity, capability_check=checker,
+                time_in_force="gtc", cycle_id=self.cycle_id,
+            )
+        else:
+            placed = orders.submit_trailing_stop_sell(
+                asset=asset, qty=request.quantity, known_position_qty=request.quantity,
+                capability_check=checker, trail_percent=D("1.0"),
+                time_in_force="gtc", cycle_id=self.cycle_id,
+            )
+        self.protective_id = placed.order_id
+        return {"broker_order_id": placed.order_id}
+
+    async def submit_exit_order(self, request: object) -> dict[str, str]:
+        from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.orders import OrderPurpose as AlpacaPurpose
+
+        intent = OrderIntent(
+            intent_id=f"{self.cycle_id}-exit", client_order_id=f"{self.cycle_id}-exit-client",
+            account_scope_id=self.adapter.scope.scope_id, cycle_id=self.cycle_id,
+            symbol=self.symbol, side=OrderSide.SELL, purpose=OrderPurpose.MANUAL_CLOSE,
+            order_type=OrderType.MARKET, time_in_force=TimeInForce.DAY,
+            created_at=datetime.now(UTC), quantity=request.quantity,
+        )
+        _ = AlpacaPurpose  # document that adapter uses the broker order purpose scheme
+        order = await self.adapter.submit_order(intent)
+        self.exit_id = order.broker_order_id
+        return {"broker_order_id": self.exit_id}
+
+    async def cancel_order(self, order_id: str) -> object:
+        return await self.adapter.cancel_order(order_id)
+
+
+def _wait_order(adapter: AlpacaBrokerAdapter, order_id: str, timeout: float = 60) -> object:
+    end = time.monotonic() + timeout
+    while time.monotonic() < end:
+        order = asyncio.run(adapter.get_order(order_id))
+        if order is not None and (order.status.value in {"FILLED", "CANCELED", "REJECTED", "EXPIRED"}
+                                  or order.filled_quantity > 0):
+            if order.filled_quantity > 0 or order.status.value in {"CANCELED", "REJECTED", "EXPIRED"}:
+                return order
+        time.sleep(1)
+    raise AssertionError(f"timed out polling paper order {order_id}")
+

def _text(value: object, name: str, *, optional: bool = False) -> str | None:
    if value is None and optional:
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-empty string")
    return value.strip()


def _decimal(value: Decimal | None, name: str, *, optional: bool = False) -> Decimal | None:
    if value is None and optional:
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be Decimal")
    if not value.is_finite() or value < ZERO:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite and non-negative")
    return value

    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError("occurred_at must be timezone-aware")
    return value.astimezone(UTC)

+    def __init__(self, *, fail_cancel: bool = False, fail_protection: bool = False) -> None:
+        self.fail_cancel = fail_cancel
+        self.fail_protection = fail_protection
+        self.calls: list[tuple[str, object]] = []
+        self.sequence = 0
+
+    async def submit_protective_order(self, request: object) -> dict[str, str]:
+        self.calls.append(("protect", request.quantity))
+        if self.fail_protection:
+            raise RuntimeError("protection state unknown")
+        self.sequence += 1
+        return {"broker_order_id": f"stop-{self.sequence}"}
+
+    async def submit_exit_order(self, request: object) -> dict[str, str]:
+        self.calls.append(("exit", request.quantity))
+        self.sequence += 1
+        return {"broker_order_id": f"exit-{self.sequence}"}
+
+    async def cancel_order(self, order_id: str) -> None:
+        self.calls.append(("cancel", order_id))
+        if self.fail_cancel:
+            raise RuntimeError("cancel outcome unknown")
+
+
+def fixed_policy() -> ProtectionPolicy:
+    return ProtectionPolicy(
+        mode=ProtectionMode.FIXED, distance_percent=D("5"),
+        time_in_force=TimeInForce.GTC,
+    )

+"""Credential and approval gated Alpaca PAPER order lifecycle verification.
+
+This module is deliberately the only test module here that can open a broker
+connection.  It constructs the production adapter for PAPER and checks the
+resolved endpoint before the first request.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import os
+import time
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from urllib.parse import urlsplit
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.app import AlpacaBrokerAdapter
+from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.auth import AlpacaEnvironment
+from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.capabilities import (
+    CapabilityDescriptor,
+    CapabilityStatus,
+    default_alpaca_capabilities,
+)
+from mike_trade.domain.accounts import AccountEnvironment
+from mike_trade.domain.trading import (
+    OrderIntent,
+    OrderPurpose,
+    OrderSide,
+    OrderType,
+    TimeInForce,
+)
+from mike_trade.risk.protection import ProtectionCoordinator
+from mike_trade.risk.stop_policy import (
+    BrokerProtectionCapabilities,
+    ProtectionMode,
+    ProtectionPolicy,
+)
+from mike_trade.runtime import ExecutionMode
+
+D = Decimal
+PAPER_KEY = "ALPACA_PAPER_KEY_ID"
+PAPER_SECRET = "ALPACA_PAPER_SECRET_KEY"
+LIVE_CREDENTIAL_NAMES = (
+    "ALPACA_LIVE_KEY_ID",
+    "ALPACA_LIVE_SECRET_KEY",
+    "APCA_API_KEY_ID",
+    "APCA_API_SECRET_KEY",
+    "MIKE_TRADE_ALPACA_LIVE_KEY_ID",
+    "MIKE_TRADE_ALPACA_LIVE_SECRET_KEY",
+)
+
+# Presence alone is enough to stop the module.  Never fetch, print, or use the
+# value of any LIVE credential.
+_live_names_set = [name for name in LIVE_CREDENTIAL_NAMES if name in os.environ]
+if _live_names_set:
+    pytest.exit(
+        "Alpaca PAPER integration aborted: LIVE credential variable(s) are set: "
+        + ", ".join(_live_names_set),
+        returncode=4,
+    )
+
+_missing = [name for name in (PAPER_KEY, PAPER_SECRET) if not os.environ.get(name)]
+if os.environ.get("MIKE_TRADE_PAPER_ORDERS_APPROVED") != "1":
+    _missing.append("MIKE_TRADE_PAPER_ORDERS_APPROVED=1 explicit operator opt-in")
+if not os.environ.get("MIKE_TRADE_PAPER_SYMBOL", "").strip():
+    _missing.append("MIKE_TRADE_PAPER_SYMBOL operator-selected liquid symbol")
+if _missing:
+    pytest.skip(
+        "Alpaca PAPER order cycle skipped; missing precondition(s): " + ", ".join(_missing),
+        allow_module_level=True,
+    )
+
+
+class _Clock:
+    def now(self) -> datetime:
+        return datetime.now(UTC)
+
+
+def _paper_endpoint() -> str:
+    # The production client derives this directly from the adapter's PAPER
+    # environment.  This explicit resolution is checked before startup/network.
+    return AlpacaEnvironment.PAPER.base_url
+
+
+class _ProtectionBroker:
+    """Small bridge to the adapter's real order and asset services."""
+
+    def __init__(self, adapter: AlpacaBrokerAdapter, symbol: str, cycle_id: str,
+                 entry_price: Decimal, qty: Decimal, style: str) -> None:
+        self.adapter, self.symbol, self.cycle_id = adapter, symbol, cycle_id
+        self.entry_price, self.qty, self.style = entry_price, qty, style
+        self.protective_id: str | None = None
+        self.exit_id: str | None = None
+
+    async def submit_protective_order(self, request: object) -> dict[str, str]:
+        orders = self.adapter._orders
+        assets = self.adapter._assets
+        assert orders is not None and assets is not None
+        asset = assets.get_asset(self.symbol)
+        checker = default_alpaca_capabilities().as_legacy_checker(AlpacaEnvironment.PAPER)
+        if self.style == "fixed":
+            price = (self.entry_price * D("0.97")).quantize(D("0.01"))
+            placed = orders.submit_stop_sell(
+                asset=asset, qty=request.quantity, stop_price=price,
+                known_position_qty=request.quantity, capability_check=checker,
+                time_in_force="gtc", cycle_id=self.cycle_id,
+            )
+        else:
+            placed = orders.submit_trailing_stop_sell(
+                asset=asset, qty=request.quantity, known_position_qty=request.quantity,
+                capability_check=checker, trail_percent=D("1.0"),
+                time_in_force="gtc", cycle_id=self.cycle_id,
+            )
+        self.protective_id = placed.order_id
+        return {"broker_order_id": placed.order_id}
+
+    async def submit_exit_order(self, request: object) -> dict[str, str]:
+        from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.orders import OrderPurpose as AlpacaPurpose
+
+        intent = OrderIntent(
+            intent_id=f"{self.cycle_id}-exit", client_order_id=f"{self.cycle_id}-exit-client",
+            account_scope_id=self.adapter.scope.scope_id, cycle_id=self.cycle_id,
+            symbol=self.symbol, side=OrderSide.SELL, purpose=OrderPurpose.MANUAL_CLOSE,
+            order_type=OrderType.MARKET, time_in_force=TimeInForce.DAY,
+            created_at=datetime.now(UTC), quantity=request.quantity,
+        )
+        _ = AlpacaPurpose  # document that adapter uses the broker order purpose scheme
+        order = await self.adapter.submit_order(intent)
+        self.exit_id = order.broker_order_id
+        return {"broker_order_id": self.exit_id}
+
+    async def cancel_order(self, order_id: str) -> object:
+        return await self.adapter.cancel_order(order_id)
+
+
+def _wait_order(adapter: AlpacaBrokerAdapter, order_id: str, timeout: float = 60) -> object:
+    end = time.monotonic() + timeout
+    while time.monotonic() < end:
+        order = asyncio.run(adapter.get_order(order_id))
+        if order is not None and (order.status.value in {"FILLED", "CANCELED", "REJECTED", "EXPIRED"}
+                                  or order.filled_quantity > 0):
+            if order.filled_quantity > 0 or order.status.value in {"CANCELED", "REJECTED", "EXPIRED"}:
+                return order
+        time.sleep(1)
+    raise AssertionError(f"timed out polling paper order {order_id}")
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("protection", ["fixed", "native_trailing"])
+def test_real_alpaca_paper_buy_protect_and_flat_cycle(protection: str) -> None:
+    symbol = os.environ["MIKE_TRADE_PAPER_SYMBOL"].strip().upper()
+    quantity_text = os.environ.get("MIKE_TRADE_PAPER_QTY", "1").strip()
+    quantity = D(quantity_text)
+    assert quantity == quantity.to_integral_value() and D("0") < quantity <= D("5"), (
+        "paper cycle quantity must be a whole-share Decimal from 1 through 5"
+    )
+    configured_mode = ExecutionMode(os.environ.get("MIKE_TRADE_MODE", "PAPER").upper())
+    assert configured_mode is ExecutionMode.PAPER
+    endpoint = _paper_endpoint()
+    assert AlpacaEnvironment.from_base_url(endpoint) is AlpacaEnvironment.PAPER
+    assert urlsplit(endpoint).hostname != AlpacaEnvironment.LIVE.base_url.split("//", 1)[1]
+
+    adapter = AlpacaBrokerAdapter(
+        ExecutionMode.PAPER, f"paper-it-{uuid4().hex[:10]}", _Clock(),
+        authorized=False, environ=os.environ,
+    )
+    assert adapter.mode is ExecutionMode.PAPER
+    adapter.validate_startup()
+    assert adapter._client is not None
+    assert adapter._client.environment is AlpacaEnvironment.PAPER
+    assert adapter._client.base_url == endpoint
+    assert urlsplit(adapter._client.base_url).hostname == "paper-api.alpaca.markets"
+    assert urlsplit(adapter._client.base_url).hostname != "api.alpaca.markets"
+
+    clock = adapter._account.get_clock()
+    if not clock.is_open:
+        pytest.skip(f"Alpaca PAPER market clock is closed; next open {clock.next_open.isoformat()}")
+
+    cycle = f"paper-it-{uuid4().hex[:14]}"
+    start = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(minutes=2)
+    created_order_ids: set[str] = set()
+    bought_qty = D("0")
+    try:
+        entry = OrderIntent(
+            intent_id=f"{cycle}-entry", client_order_id=f"{cycle}-entry-client",
+            account_scope_id=adapter.scope.scope_id, cycle_id=cycle, symbol=symbol,
+            side=OrderSide.BUY, purpose=OrderPurpose.ENTRY,
+            order_type=OrderType.MARKET, time_in_force=TimeInForce.DAY,
+            created_at=datetime.now(UTC), quantity=quantity,
+        )
+        submitted = asyncio.run(adapter.submit_order(entry))
+        created_order_ids.add(submitted.broker_order_id)
+        entry_result = _wait_order(adapter, submitted.broker_order_id)
+        bought_qty = entry_result.filled_quantity
+        if bought_qty <= 0:
+            pytest.skip(f"paper entry produced no fill (status={entry_result.status.value})")
+        assert bought_qty <= quantity
+        assert isinstance(entry_result.filled_avg_price, Decimal)
+
+        # REST order polling is the recovery path for the trade_updates stream;
+        # the adapter's production normalizer preserves exact Decimal values.
+        fills = asyncio.run(adapter.list_fills(start))
+        entry_activities = [f for f in fills if f.broker_order_id == submitted.broker_order_id]
+        assert sum((f.quantity for f in entry_activities), D("0")) == bought_qty
+        assert len({f.fill_id for f in entry_activities}) == len(entry_activities)
+
+        capability = CapabilityDescriptor("stop", "simple", "whole", "gtc", "sell", "submit")
+        matrix = default_alpaca_capabilities()
+        assert matrix.status_of(capability, AlpacaEnvironment.PAPER) is CapabilityStatus.PROVEN
+        if protection == "native_trailing":
+            capability = CapabilityDescriptor("trailing_stop", "simple", "whole", "gtc", "sell", "submit")
+            assert matrix.status_of(capability, AlpacaEnvironment.PAPER) is CapabilityStatus.PROVEN
+        protective_broker = _ProtectionBroker(
+            adapter, symbol, cycle, entry_result.filled_avg_price, bought_qty, protection
+        )
+        policy = ProtectionPolicy(
+            mode=(ProtectionMode.FIXED if protection == "fixed" else ProtectionMode.TRAILING_NATIVE),
+            distance_percent=D("3") if protection == "fixed" else None,
+            trail_percent=D("1") if protection == "native_trailing" else None,
+            time_in_force=TimeInForce.GTC,
+        )
+        coordinator = ProtectionCoordinator(protective_broker, _Clock(), policy)
+        cap = BrokerProtectionCapabilities(
+            supported_order_types=frozenset({"STOP_MARKET", "TRAILING_STOP"}),
+            paper_proven_order_types=frozenset({"STOP_MARKET", "TRAILING_STOP"}),
+            standalone_trailing_parameters=frozenset({"TRAIL_PERCENT"}),
+            paper_proven_standalone_trailing_parameters=frozenset({"TRAIL_PERCENT"}),
+            supported_tifs=frozenset({TimeInForce.GTC}),
+            paper_proven_tifs=frozenset({TimeInForce.GTC}),
+        )
+        decision = coordinator.check_entry_eligibility(policy, cap, ExecutionMode.PAPER, bought_qty)
+        assert decision.entry_allowed, decision.reason_code
+        protection_state = asyncio.run(coordinator.on_confirmed_fill(
+            cycle, bought_qty, entry_result.filled_avg_price, confirmed=True
+        ))
+        assert protection_state is not None
+        assert protection_state.protective_working_quantity == bought_qty
+        created_order_ids.add(protective_broker.protective_id)
+
+        # The coordinator requests stop cancellation first.  Only after broker
+        # confirms cancellation does it submit a market sell for the actual
+        # remaining position, preventing overlapping sell quantity.
+        pending = asyncio.run(coordinator.on_exit_requested(cycle, bought_qty, "paper-it-cleanup"))
+        assert pending.status.startswith("CANCEL_PENDING")

+            cycle, protective_broker.protective_id, "CANCELED", filled_qty=D("0")
+        ))
+        assert canceled.exit_working_quantity == bought_qty
+        exit_order = asyncio.run(adapter.get_order(protective_broker.exit_id))
+        assert exit_order is not None
+        created_order_ids.add(exit_order.broker_order_id)
+        exit_result = _wait_order(adapter, exit_order.broker_order_id)

+        final = asyncio.run(coordinator.on_broker_order_update(
+            cycle, exit_order.broker_order_id, "FILLED", filled_qty=exit_result.filled_quantity,

+        if test_position is not None and test_position.qty > 0:

+                account_scope_id=adapter.scope.scope_id, cycle_id=cycle, symbol=symbol,
+                side=OrderSide.SELL, purpose=OrderPurpose.MANUAL_CLOSE,

+            except Exception:

+        self.fail_protection = fail_protection
+        self.calls: list[tuple[str, object]] = []
+        self.sequence = 0
+
+    async def submit_protective_order(self, request: object) -> dict[str, str]:
+        self.calls.append(("protect", request.quantity))
+        if self.fail_protection:
+            raise RuntimeError("protection state unknown")
+        self.sequence += 1
+        return {"broker_order_id": f"stop-{self.sequence}"}
+
+    async def submit_exit_order(self, request: object) -> dict[str, str]:
+        self.calls.append(("exit", request.quantity))
+        self.sequence += 1
+        return {"broker_order_id": f"exit-{self.sequence}"}
+
+    async def cancel_order(self, order_id: str) -> None:
+        self.calls.append(("cancel", order_id))

+

+PAPER_SECRET = "ALPACA_PAPER_SECRET_KEY"

+)
+
+# Presence alone is enough to stop the module.  Never fetch, print, or use the
+# value of any LIVE credential.
+_live_names_set = [name for name in LIVE_CREDENTIAL_NAMES if name in os.environ]
+if _live_names_set:
+    pytest.exit(
+        "Alpaca PAPER integration aborted: LIVE credential variable(s) are set: "
+        + ", ".join(_live_names_set),

+

+        if self.style == "fixed":
